## Purpose
A React context provider holding the session-scoped list of skills and hooks the user has attached, so any component under it (idea input, agent drawer, composer) can read or mutate the current attachment set without prop-drilling.

## Shape
- `SkillsHooksContextValue` — the context shape: `attachedSkills`/`attachedHooks` arrays plus `attachSkill`/`detachSkill`/`attachHook`/`detachHook`/`clearAll` mutators.
- `SkillsHooksProvider` — owns the two arrays via `useState`, exposes the mutators as `useCallback`-memoized functions, and renders the context provider around `children`.
- `useSkillsHooks` — the consumer hook; throws if called outside a `SkillsHooksProvider`.

## Why this shape
A standard React context-provider-plus-hook pattern; `attachSkill`/`attachHook` dedupe by `id` before appending, and no explicit rationale is given beyond that in the code.
